name: Founding Camp
description: Canvas is drawn tight over the first survey stake. Walk through the flap to find the cords and rack inside.

stations.name: Inspect the survey line
stations.detail: Salt has stiffened the first length of rope. The newer splice runs smooth through the fid.

stations.name: Read the stake rack
stations.detail: Four cuts on the rack match the four stones at the edge of the founding plot.

name: Landing Hall
description: The cedar hall stands on the same foundation stones. The plot’s first survey chart hangs above the work shelf.

stations.name: Unfold the working chart
stations.detail: The slip and the sea arch line up along the chart’s worn fold. The founding pin still marks the threshold.

stations.name: Examine the timber rack
stations.detail: Each tie holds one dry length above the damp floor. Shorter offcuts have been saved for gate pins.

name: Defended Landing
description: A stone footing supports the old hall and its new lookout. The signal cord runs down to the gate bar.

stations.name: Check the spare gate pins
stations.detail: The top pin has a bright stripe where the new bar has rubbed away the oil.

stations.name: Inspect the gate stores
stations.detail: Cord, lamp oil and spare pegs are stacked in the order the lookout needs them.

stations.name: Inspect the watch shelf
stations.detail: The watch slate faces the gate below. Three shell chips along its rim mark the night watches.

stations.name: Trace the signal cord
stations.detail: The cord passes through a polished brass eye and drops straight to the gate bar below.
